# Solaris Nutri

> Solaris Nutri is a rhythm-based nutrition practice helping midlife women rebuild their energy and metabolism around their biological rhythms — not another diet.

Solaris Nutri blends TCM spleen health, circadian nutrition, and light-as-a-nutrient principles into the Solaris Nutri Framework (formerly Quantum Rhythm Nutrition). Programs run in two formats: a group Collective and a private 1:1 journey, both grounded in PubMed-referenced research on fiber, light, and metabolic health.
